text.text: Cisco MDS 9710 Director

The Cisco MDS 9710 Director is now 64 G ready! Cisco MDS 9710 Director establishes a new benchmark for performance – delivering more than three times the bandwidth of any Director in the industry – future-proofing storage connectivity for mission-critical applications, massive amounts of data, All Flash Arrays and cloud-based environments, while preserving current IT operations and knowledge.

text.text: Front View

Cisco introduces the Unified Fabric next-generation Storage Network. The new Cisco MDS 9710 Director establishes a new benchmark for performance – delivering more than three times the bandwidth of any Director in the industry – future-proofing storage connectivity for mission-critical applications, massive amounts of data, Solid State Drives (SSD) and cloud-based environments, while preserving current IT operations and knowledge. Cisco takes the MDS heritage of non-stop, decade of operations to the next level with the MDS 9710 – industry’s most reliable storage Director with N+1 fabric, fully redundant components and fault-tolerant architectural design. The next generation MDS innovations, a key component of the Cisco Unified Data Center, provide unmatched flexibility with its multi-protocol innovations unlike disparate solutions. The freedom of choice coupled with a single, proven operating system and management enable an evolutionary adoption and consistent SAN and LAN networking operations.

text.text: The MDS 9710 features two new Supervisor Modules (Sup-4) and allows for redundant operation as well as online upgrades to software with ISSU (In Service Software Upgrade). Each Supervisor Module also has LED's that indicate System and Supervisor status, power management, logging to flash and other important indicators for a visual overview of the system.

text.text: The MDS 9710 supports up to 8 AC or DC power-supplies. Although the system needs only 3 to operate at full capacity, populating extra power-supplies allows for N+1 redundancy so a single power-supply failure does not affect system operation as well as N:N grid redundancy where half the power-supplies are from one power-grid and the rest from a second power-grid to design for power-grid failures.

text.text: Fabric Cards on the MDS 9710 support a crossbar architecture that guarantees low variance on the latency through the switch. Each fabric card supports 512Gbps of backplane bandwidth per slot and each fabric is hot-swappable. This allows for up to 3Tbps per slot of front-panel FC bandwidth with all six fabric cards in place. The chassis supports a total of six fabric cards. For all 384 16G ports on the front panel, only three fabric cards are required for line-rate. Any additional fabric cards provide redundancy for no change to speed in case of a fabric card failure.

text.text: Three fan-trays are installed on the back of the MDS 9710. The fans on each fan-tray are monitored and any failures reported through LED's as well as through NX-OS. Fan-trays can be removed and replaced without turning the switch off at normal data-center temperatures - for either fan-tray replacement or adding/changing fabric cards that are behind the fan trays. Fan trays also have LED indicators for status of fabric cards behind them.
